Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; GREATER MINNESOTA REGIONAL PARKS AND TRAILS COMMISSION. +]

bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to natural resources; appropriating money for Greater Minnesota Regional Parks and Trails Commission.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; GREATER MINNESOTA REGIONAL PARKS AND TRAILS COMMISSION.

$500,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $500,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of natural resources for the Greater Minnesota Regional Parks and Trails Commission to carry out its duties under Minnesota Statutes, section 85.536.
additions: APPROPRIATION; GREATER MINNESOTA REGIONAL PARKS AND TRAILS COMMISSION.

$500,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $500,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of natural resources for the Greater Minnesota Regional Parks and Trails Commission to carry out its duties under Minnesota Statutes, section 85.536.
